title: situation.s13_cabinet_remonstrance.title

gate.none: Proposed for review: this paper concerns military command, administration or finance; it contains no policy toward a protected population, security order or atrocity consequence.

citations.at: vol. I pp. 94–99; entry of 31 August 1862; the paper, signature requests and Welles’s alternative.

namedOnly: Other names identify the addressees, subjects or prospective appointees in the dated document. Only the declared speakers act in issuing or reporting this document; its receipt makes no appointment and does not assert that an addressee still holds a historical office.
